page.overview:
What is Snowpoint Gym?

The Snowpoint Gym (キッサキジム Kissaki Gym) is the gym run by Candice located in the Sinnoh region in Snowpoint City. It is based on -type Pokémon. It is a Gym consisting of a four-floor ice rink with slides connecting the random floors. The character has to move or brake the snowballs to get through. When finished, it should have one straight line to follow. If the challenger wins, the person will receive the Icicle Badge.
